case: An acceptance commits on a verdict from an instrument with no current calibration.
why: 06 section 7 says a verdict from an instrument whose refusal rate on correct artifacts is unrecorded is `unresolved` and MAY NOT SATISFY AN ACCEPTANCE GATE, and nothing bound the two: no record in the registry related to `InstrumentCalibration`, and `criterion.AcceptanceInterval.accepted.v1` required only a resolution reason, an acceptance owner and a criteria ref. With this binding optional the acceptance commits on a checker with no calibration in `run` at all, which is the state every checker is in before its first calibration session.
